title: Unit 117
hook: The night guard at the storage place left one rule: if unit 117 is ever unlocked, lock it... and don't look inside.
lines: I work nights at a self-storage place off the highway. Rows and rows of metal doors.
The guard before me left one rule, taped to the monitor.
If unit one-seventeen is ever unlocked... lock it. Do not look inside.
For weeks, every lock was shut. I walked the rows at two a.m. and heard nothing but the wind rattling the doors.
Then one night, the padlock on one-seventeen was hanging open.
The door was up a few inches. Warm light spilled out underneath... like someone had a lamp on in there.
I knelt to pull it down. I didn't mean to look.
A rug. A little table. And my coffee mug... the chipped one from my kitchen.
I slammed the door and snapped the lock shut.
Back in the office, I pulled the rental file for one-seventeen.
My name. My signature. My handwriting.
Behind me, the office door swung shut... and I heard a padlock click.
